metadata.description: Claude Code plugins: terminal mods (readable replies, a working band, prompt cards) and version-pinned documentation skills for VFX and pipeline software.

plugins.name: pretty-markdown
plugins.description: Bordered code blocks with copy and fold, inline-code chips, coloured diffs, tables, headings, callouts and a Next: box.

plugins.name: working-band
plugins.description: A live line above the prompt while Claude works, tidier tool rows, and a turn footer with tool and file counts.

plugins.name: prompt-cards
plugins.description: Your prompts as blue cards, dimmed while queued, and /prompts to jump to any one.

plugins.name: dev
plugins.description: Development skills: coding conventions and workflows, starting with Python.

plugins.name: vfx
plugins.description: Version-pinned documentation skills for VFX and pipeline software (Houdini, Blender, Cinema 4D, OpenUSD, Unreal, rez, Deadline), searchable offline.
